issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, нет такого мужа, который, хоть на час бы не мечтал стать холостяком!
issues.translation_quote: As our dear boss says, there isn't a husband alive who hasn't dreamed of being single for at least an hour!
issues.justification: Fine; but the earlier boss aphorism 'если человек идиот - то это надолго' is rendered 'it's for life', losing the phrase's wry pattern. (Minor loss.)

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания... Значит, этот лопух ничего не знает.
issues.translation_quote: Those morons swore he was unconscious... So that sucker knows nothing.
issues.justification: 'Лопух' (simpleton) rendered as 'sucker' is acceptable, but elsewhere 'Лопух' becomes 'sucker', 'mark' and 'dummy', creating terminology inconsistency for a recurring character label.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I can't go along with that!
issues.justification: The non-standard 'пойтить' marks Lyolik/Gesha's feigned folksy speech; register flattened.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets today and win yourself a... Waterworks plant!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) is lost; the comic doggerel is rendered as flat prose.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you drop dead! May I see you in a coffin, in your white funeral slippers! May you live... on nothing but... your salary!
issues.justification: The accented Odessa-style speech and the punchline curse are weakened; the humor of the escalating curses is partially lost.

issues.source_quote: Лёгким движением руки брюки превращаются... в элегантные шорты!
issues.translation_quote: With a flick of the wrist, the trousers become... elegant shorts!
issues.justification: The famous 'брюки превращаются' gag is retained, though the Soviet fashion-show parody voice is neutral.
